protocol.launchDefinition: Fresh process launch to the same local page reaching document.readyState complete, with the native browser panel opened. Warm OS file cache; normal cached license; includes automation overhead. Not a machine-reboot cold-start or an Internet speed measurement.
protocol.backgroundDefinition: Five visited public pages, both browsers hidden, matched individual viewports, complete documents, no discarded tabs. Native CPU time converted from Mach ticks with mach_timebase_info. CPU is one-core percent.
protocol.batteryNote: Full battery discharge and whole-system energy were not measured. Administrative access to powermetrics was unavailable. CPU work and kernel energy counters cannot establish battery hours or battery-life savings.

audit.cpuUnit: Mach ticks converted through the device's mach_timebase_info
